h1: Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector P – The Caladan
intro:
Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector P, marketed as The Caladan, is a premium residential sector within FT-II. Buyers commonly search for its current plot sizes, discounted full-payment prices, map position, development status and available inventory.

The July 2026 Sector P rate schedule includes residential plots from 5.56 marla to 2 kanal. Prices and availability can change, so confirm the exact plot, current payable amount and written booking terms before payment.
body:
## Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector P overview

Sector P is part of Faisal Town Phase 2 and is marketed as The Caladan.

Current project and market material consistently use both “Sector P” and “The Caladan,” while some property listings may also use the informal phrase “P Block.”

For clarity, this page uses the master-plan terminology Sector P.

The sector currently has a defined residential price schedule covering several plot sizes, making it particularly relevant to buyers comparing a known purchase price rather than relying only on general resale quotations.

However, the price schedule should still be treated as a dated offer reference. Availability, premium locations and final payable amounts should be confirmed before booking.

## Sector P / The Caladan location and map

Sector P is located within Faisal Town Phase 2.

Current project-focused material places The Caladan around the Thalian Interchange side of the project, making its access and position within the wider Phase 2 plan an important part of the buying decision.

Use the dedicated Sector P plan to identify:

- main access
- sector boundaries
- major roads
- internal streets
- plot locations
- surrounding sectors
- nearby commercial or amenity areas

For a shortlisted property, ask for the exact plot number and match it with the current Sector P plan.

A sector-level promotional image is not enough for a purchase decision.

If possible, visit the site or request a fresh live video showing the plot location, access road and surrounding development.

## Sector P plot sizes

The July 2026 Sector P price schedule includes the following residential categories:

- 5.56 marla
- 8 marla
- 10.89 marla
- 14.22 marla
- 1 kanal
- 2 kanal

The 2-kanal category may appear with more than one price depending on the specific size or location category.

Always verify the actual dimensions of the property from the current plan and booking documents rather than relying only on the rounded marla description.

This matters especially when comparing larger plots or properties with special locations.

## Sector P prices

A July 2026 Sector P offer published for The Caladan shows the following actual and discounted lump-sum prices:

| Plot Size | Listed Price | Discounted Full-Payment Price |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 5.56 Marla | PKR 4,490,000 | PKR 3,590,000 |
| 8 Marla | PKR 6,250,000 | PKR 4,990,000 |
| 10.89 Marla | PKR 8,240,000 | PKR 6,590,000 |
| 14.22 Marla | PKR 10,440,000 | PKR 8,350,000 |
| 1 Kanal | PKR 14,150,000 | PKR 11,290,000 |
| 2 Kanal | PKR 27,280,000 | PKR 21,790,000 |
| 2 Kanal | PKR 29,090,000 | PKR 23,270,000 |

These figures should be treated as the dated Sector P offer currently referenced by this website, not as a permanent guaranteed price.

Before booking, confirm:

- whether the offer is still active
- the exact plot available
- the applicable discount
- any special-location premium
- total payable amount
- development charges
- transfer or processing charges
- taxes and other transaction costs

Current market listings broadly reflect these lump-sum values, including approximately PKR 4.99 million for 8 marla and PKR 11.29 million for 1 kanal inventory. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

## Discounted full-payment offer

The Sector P pricing currently shown on this website is based on discounted full-payment rates.

Published July 2026 pricing indicates a substantial reduction from the listed price when the property is purchased under the applicable lump-sum offer.

Do not assume that every future Sector P plot will receive the same discount.

Before sending payment, obtain current written confirmation of:

- original listed price
- discount percentage
- final discounted amount
- offer expiry, if any
- booking procedure
- accepted payment method
- recipient details
- official receipt process

A screenshot of an old rate sheet should not be used as final proof of the payable amount.

## Sector P payment checks

Different Phase 2 sectors may have different installment or lump-sum structures, so Sector P should be checked on its own terms.

Before booking, ask for a written payment summary showing:

- booking amount
- total plot price
- discount applied
- remaining balance
- installment position, if applicable
- development charges
- possession charges
- location premium
- transfer or documentation charges
- taxes

Some current project-focused sources state that development charges are included in the Sector P price and that lump-sum full payment may receive a 20% discount, but these details should still be reconfirmed against the exact current offer. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}

## Special-location charges

A plot with a premium location may cost more than a standard plot of the same size.

Possible premium categories can include:

- corner
- main road
- wider road
- park-facing
- open-facing
- boulevard position
- other specially designated locations

Ask whether any extra percentage or fixed premium applies before comparing two plots.

A lower advertised base price can become less attractive once special-location charges and transaction costs are added.

## Sector P plots for sale

Sector P has current market inventory across multiple residential sizes.

Recent listings include 8-marla, 1-kanal and 2-kanal properties, demonstrating that The Caladan is already appearing in the active resale or cash-payment market. :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}

Before comparing listings, establish whether the advertisement represents:

- fresh developer inventory
- discounted cash booking
- resale inventory
- fully paid property
- partially paid property
- inventory with outstanding charges

Two advertisements for the same plot size may not represent the same financial position.

Compare the total payable amount rather than only the headline asking price.

## Sector P development status

Development claims should be verified for the exact location.

Current market and project material positions Sector P as an actively marketed Phase 2 sector, but individual streets and plot locations may be at different stages.

During a site visit, look for:

- road formation
- street demarcation
- drainage or sewerage work
- electricity infrastructure
- plot marking
- machinery and active construction
- surrounding development
- access to the sector

If an agent claims that a particular plot is developed or nearing possession, ask for current supporting evidence relevant to that exact property.

## How to compare Sector P plot options

Start by comparing properties within the same plot-size category.

For example, if you are considering an 8-marla plot, ask for two or three currently available 8-marla options rather than comparing one 8-marla property with a larger or smaller category.

Then compare:

- final payable price
- exact street
- road width
- corner or standard position
- proximity to main access
- surrounding development
- payment completion
- special-location premium

This gives a much better indication of value than choosing from a single advertisement.

## Is Sector P / The Caladan good for investment?

Sector P may appeal to buyers who prefer a current Phase 2 sector with a clearly published price schedule and multiple plot-size options.

However, investment suitability still depends on the individual plot and the price paid.

Consider:

- entry price
- plot size
- exact location
- current development
- payment structure
- expected holding period
- resale activity
- competing Phase 2 inventory
- total acquisition cost

Do not assume future appreciation simply because the sector is branded The Caladan.

A strong purchase still requires a sensible entry price and a desirable plot location.

## Who Sector P may suit

Sector P may be relevant to buyers who want:

- a currently marketed Phase 2 sector
- several residential plot-size options
- a published price reference
- lump-sum discount opportunities
- larger plot categories including 1 and 2 kanal

It may be less suitable for a buyer who specifically requires a long installment plan, immediate possession or a different access position.

Those buyers should compare Sector P with other available Faisal Town Phase 2 sectors before deciding.

## Sector P vs other Faisal Town Phase 2 sectors

Sector P should be compared with Sector O, Sector R, Sector T and Overseas Enclave according to your budget and intended use.

Compare:

- plot sizes
- current prices
- development
- payment structure
- access
- resale availability
- premium charges
- total purchase cost

Sector P may provide a better fit for a buyer seeking The Caladan's current price offer, while another sector may better suit a buyer prioritizing installment flexibility or a different location.

## Sector P site-visit checklist

Before making a final booking decision, match the property to the dedicated Sector P map.

During the site visit, check:

- exact plot number
- street or road
- access from the main route
- road width
- surrounding development
- ground level
- drainage
- corner or premium position
- nearby construction
- distance from important sector access points

For a remote buyer, request a fresh marked map, live location pin and video walkthrough for the exact plot.

Do not rely only on the promotional Sector P image or an old screenshot.

faqsText:
Is The Caladan the same as Sector P? | Yes. Current Faisal Town Phase 2 market and payment-plan material identifies The Caladan as Sector P.

Is P Block the same as Sector P? | Some market listings may use P Block informally, but this website uses the Phase 2 master-plan term Sector P to avoid confusion with Phase 1 block naming.

What plot sizes are available in Sector P? | The current Sector P price schedule includes 5.56, 8, 10.89 and 14.22 marla plots as well as 1 kanal and 2 kanal categories.

What is the price of an 8-marla plot in Sector P? | The July 2026 rate schedule lists an 8-marla plot at PKR 6.25 million with a discounted full-payment price of PKR 4.99 million. Confirm the current offer before booking.

What is the price of a 1-kanal plot in Sector P? | The July 2026 schedule lists 1 kanal at PKR 14.15 million with a discounted full-payment price of PKR 11.29 million. Current availability should be verified before payment.

Is there a full-payment discount in Sector P? | Current published pricing shows discounted lump-sum rates. Confirm the applicable discount and final payable amount in writing for the exact plot before booking.

Are development charges included? | Current Sector P marketing material states that development charges are included in the published price, but this should be reconfirmed for the exact current offer.

Are extra charges applied to corner or main-road plots? | Special-location premiums may apply to corner, main-road, park-facing or other preferred plots. Ask for the exact premium before comparing prices.

Can I download the Sector P plan? | Yes. The dedicated Sector P FT-II plan is available on this page.

Is Sector P good for investment? | It may suit some buyers, but the entry price, exact plot location, development, total payable amount and resale demand should be evaluated before purchasing.
